body.x: emCT Co., Ltd. (CEO Bongho Lee) announced that it has firmly established a foundation for global market entry through its intelligent fire safety solutions and related technological capabilities at CES 2026, the world’s largest IT and tech exhibition held in Las Vegas early last month.

emCT is a domestic startup that has developed fire safety management and building control technology since its establishment in 2021. In particular, BDApp, developed using advanced technologies such as AI and IoT (Internet of Things), attracted industry attention by providing integrated control of various building facilities, as well as predictive and maintenance functions, including failure cause analysis, malfunction recovery, and real-time evacuation guidance.

Additionally, emCT operates the Fire Safe Zone service, which uses 3D building maps and evacuation routes based on automatic drawing recognition technology that won a CES Innovation Award last year. The company explains that it helps minimize damage to lives and property from fires by leading with solutions that support intelligent building control, management, and effective emergency response.

At CES 2026, emCT also showcased its Fire Watch service, which enables continuous monitoring and immediate fire detection across buildings and facilities, demonstrating the scalability and completeness of its fire safety solution portfolio.

Fire Watch is a fire detection solution that analyzes visual indicators such as smoke, flames, and heat distortion observed in real-time CCTV footage through AI algorithms, accurately and quickly identifying fires to provide alarms and notifications in emergencies.

The company designed the algorithms for this solution using lightweight AI models optimized for on-device environments, such as embedded and edge systems. The system processes data in real time, enabling fire detection without delay, and can operate continuously even in environments without networks or with unstable connections. Furthermore, it integrates easily with existing video surveillance systems.

Reports indicate that emCT currently has local subsidiaries in Virginia, USA, and Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, and is expanding partnerships and PoCs with industries in various countries, starting with its fire safety solutions. Moreover, at CES 2026, the company laid the groundwork for entry into additional regions and countries by conducting approximately 30 consultations during the exhibition, totaling approximately USD 18.2 million (approximately 26.352 billion KRW).

An emCT official expressed their feelings, stating, “While we are pursuing the establishment of a global network through participation in domestic and international exhibitions and active marketing activities, we feel pleased to achieve meaningful results on the world stage of CES.”

They added, “The consultation scale exceeding 25 billion KRW serves as an indicator representing the global market’s interest and expectations for intelligent and reliable fire safety technology.” They concluded, “We will utilize the network secured at CES 2026 as an opportunity for practical partnerships and global commercialization, thereby emerging as a company that supports the safety of customers worldwide and efficient building control.”

Incheon Metropolitan City and the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority announced that they will establish the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion in the LVCC North Hall at CES 2026, showcasing Incheon’s urban vision and innovative technologies as the city evolves from smart city development into the AI era. By linking various exhibition programs—including the 10 companies participating in the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion, Eureka Park, global pavilions, and the CES Innovation Award Showcase—the organizations will support the participation of 51 Incheon-based innovative companies at CES. Notably, 14 companies received CES Innovation Awards across 17 categories, marking a record-high achievement and demonstrating the technological competitiveness and global growth potential of Incheon’s innovation companies.
